question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"linked to".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given phrase is **"linked to".**
 
• The phrase **"linked to"** generally means there is a connection or association between two or more things. (जुड़ा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** *Lack of physical exercise is strongly **linked to** increase in Heart diseases.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase suggests a connection between elevated blood sugar levels and the occurrence or progression of various health issues.
 
• Hence, **"linked to"** should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

**Complete Sentence:** *A healthy diet is (1) ** rich __** in fibre, whole grains, fresh fruits and vegetables, "good" or unsaturated fats, and omega-3 fatty acids. These dietary components turn down inflammation, which can (2)**__ damage __** tissue, joints, artery walls and organs. Going easy on processed foods is another (3)**__ element __** of healthy eating. Sweets, foods made with highly refined grains, and sugar-sweetened beverages can (4)**__ cause __** spikes in blood sugar that can lead to early hunger. High blood sugar is (5)**__ linked to __** the development of diabetes, obesity, heart disease and even dementia.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Source of:** It refers to the origin, cause, or point from which something originates. (स्रोत)
 
• **made of:** It refers to the material or composition from which an object or substance is constructed. (बना होना)
 
• **affiliated to:** It indicates a formal association, connection, or relationship between two entities. (से संबद्ध)
